verdict: Leads are coming in affordably, but none are reaching your pipeline.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 122 leads from Meta at $14.60 per lead — well below your historical range — so ad performance is not the problem. The problem is what happens after a lead arrives: zero opportunities have been created in your CRM, meaning none of those 122 leads has moved toward becoming a case. SMS automation and phone access, both needed to close that gap, are being activated now alongside case tracking and auto-logging in your system, which went live this week. Google Business Profile engagement also dropped sharply week-over-week, and a posting cadence was launched on September 30th to rebuild that local visibility heading into next period.

watch_item.issue: None of this period's 122 leads have entered your case pipeline, pointing to a contact and intake gap rather than an ad problem.
watch_item.fix: Case tracking, CRM auto-logging, and lead-routing automation went live this week — pipeline movement is expected to appear in next week's numbers.
